note: Online: the portal builds its own checklist

item: Family Information (IMM 5645 or IMM 5707 as the region requires)
note: Age 18 or older; the visa-office instructions name the form

item: Proof of payment (processing fee; biometrics fee if needed)
Passport or travel document: information page (blank page available)

note: Not needed when biometrics are given

item: Purpose of travel (invitation letter or itinerary)
Proof of immigration status in the country of residence
condition: lives outside the country of citizenship

item: Minor travelling alone or with one parent: custody papers or consent letter
Additional documents required by the visa office
note: Check the country-specific instructions (for example IMM 5890 for Bangladesh)
